profiles.name: xmqtt_wire
profiles.description: Bounded framing, UTF-8 topic field and fixed-header writing; no packet/session completeness or production parity claim

profiles.name: xmqtt_properties
profiles.description: MQTT 5 property-section decode/encode into caller storage; no packet/client or performance parity claim

profiles.name: xmqtt_packet
profiles.description: Private already-UTF8-validated ASCII filter grammar only; no subscription or codec throughput claim

profiles.name: xmqtt_codec5
profiles.description: Full MQTT5 QoS1 PUBLISH property/PFI decode and atomic encode in caller storage; no network/session/queueing/durability parity claim

profiles.name: xmqtt_codec311
profiles.description: Full MQTT311 binary QoS1 PUBLISH decode/atomic encode in caller storage; no network/session or cross-protocol performance claim

profiles.name: xmqtt_negotiation
profiles.description: Two validated handshake descriptors and one outbound packet check per cycle; dual version, no network/session/capacity/comparator claim

profiles.name: xmqtt_client_qos1
profiles.description: Single loopback connection to an in-process local fixture, closed-loop 32-inflight QoS1 application-observed PUBACK latency/throughput; separate heap-instrumented variants include client plus peer and first lazy id-table allocation. Excludes connect/close; not broker/comparator/production parity.

profiles.name: xmqtt_client_receive
profiles.description: Combined QoS1 publish/echo, application-observed PUBACK plus receive completion and final peer-observed receiver PUBACKs. One local fixture, two IO workers, observer, window32/payload32. Includes cold sender/receiver tables and peer costs; not receiver-only, broker parity or production acceptance.

profiles.name: xmqtt_client_disconnect
profiles.description: Whole connection/error/physical-retirement cycles on a persistent local Engine: construction, CONNECT/CONNACK, malformed header, MQTT5 diagnostic close or 311 abort, observer waits and destruction. Client plus fixture costs, cold first cache use; not isolated close latency or broker parity.

profiles.name: xmqtt_qos2_sender
profiles.description: Closed-loop full QoS2 sender on one in-process fixture/connection, window32/payload32; separate hot uninstrumented and cold/hot XRT heap-instrumented variants. Echo latency includes peer-observed final receiver ACK. CPU includes observer/fixture; no broker, comparator, open-loop, durability, native Linux or production acceptance.

profiles.name: xmqtt_qos2_echo
profiles.description: Closed-loop full QoS2 echo on one in-process fixture/connection, window32/payload32; separate hot uninstrumented and cold/hot XRT heap-instrumented variants. Echo latency includes peer-observed final receiver ACK. CPU includes observer/fixture; no broker, comparator, open-loop, durability, native Linux or production acceptance.

profiles.name: xmqtt_qos2_resolution
profiles.description: Predeclared 10x operation-count extension of the eight instrumented QoS2 sender/echo variants to reduce process CPU accounting quantization. Same runtime, source, 32-slot/32-byte workload, warmup, instrumentation and gates; prior 20k observations retained. Not product optimization or pinned acceptance.

profiles.name: xmqtt_client_auth
profiles.description: Two-round MQTT5 enhanced reauthentication on real loopback TCP with fixture tokens, nonblocking Notify decisions and signalled Future waits; excludes cryptographic work and external broker parity.

profiles.name: xmqtt_client_dial
profiles.description: Numeric/prepared/cached-host lifecycle costs on one loopback Engine/Resolver; includes CONNECT, QoS1 and actual physical retirement, no external DNS/broker parity.

profiles.name: xmqtt_client_tls
profiles.description: TLS1.3 AES128-GCM/X25519 local QoS1 closed-loop workload; includes native client/server record crypto, callback trust fixture and physical retirement, not real-broker/fixed-arrival or production acceptance

profiles.name: xmqtt_client_tls_resume
profiles.description: Local TLS1.3 full/resumed factory-to-CONNACK latency; native RSA/AES128-GCM/X25519 callback-trust fixture, fresh MQTT QoS1 and physical shutdown per setup, not broker/native production acceptance
